evals.name: baseline-practice-forms
contract_scenarios: The seven Studio diagram forms have reproducible routes
evals.prompt: From deps/platform-adoption-kernel.json, draw a practice dependency diagram, a Value concern overview, and a Value activity overview. Keep what I need to regenerate them.
evals.expected_output: Selects the three documented Keleo routes, uses the source practice and retains native specs alongside the rendered SVGs.

evals.name: state-loop-terse
contract_scenarios: State loops and orchestration placement remain visible
evals.prompt: Draw Platform's alpha states from tests/fixtures/merge-constructs/baseline.json, including the return to Built.
evals.expected_output: Uses the copied state-flow renderer and shows the guarded Operational-to-Built loop instead of reducing the model to a linear maturity stack.

evals.name: missing-practice-relation
contract_scenarios: The seven Studio diagram forms have reproducible routes
evals.prompt: Please draw an activity overview from a practice with no activitySpaces.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the activity overview has no source relation to draw; does not fabricate activities or produce an empty SVG.

evals.name: practice-pattern-briefing
contract_scenarios: Practice pattern phases retain their decisions and maturity targets
A split practice pattern keeps its cross-panel return visible
evals.prompt: Illustrate the Partner Account Planning Lifecycle pattern in practices/partner-account-planning/partner-account-planning.json for a portrait briefing. I need its phase decisions, maturity targets and return to discovery, with a full figure I can inspect.
evals.expected_output: Uses the copied Keleo Studio practice pattern renderer, retains the source JSON and full SVG, and labels portrait excerpts Part 1 and Part 2 while showing the guarded return to Discover and Analyze on Part 2.
